verdict.rationale: Turso is a SQLite-compatible edge/embedded database platform, not a workflow/automation-authoring tool; it has no concept of 'automations' to version, review, or roll back. Its branching (turso-docs-3, turso-docs-41) and point-in-time recovery (turso-docs-4, turso-docs-33) features apply to database state, not automation workflows, so this axis is a category mismatch rather than a missing capability.
